image_description: A full-body shot of a large, greyish-green common iguana standing on a grassy surface in an enclosure. The iguana is positioned diagonally from bottom-left to top-right. It features a prominent dorsal crest running down its spine, a visible dewlap under the chin, and long limbs with clawed feet. The background consists of rocky walls and some foliage.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail extends significantly beyond the body length (visible portion suggests it continues). It appears flattened (laterally compressed) rather than cylindrical, consistent with iguana anatomy.
